text: Hello, dinosaur explorers! Look, a Triceratops! It has three horns. One, two, three! Here comes Brontosaurus, with a very long neck. Tyrannosaurus rex. Spinosaurus. Pteranodon. Let's listen. What might these amazing animals have sounded like?

settings.prompt: A warm adult male American English museum guide reading a picture book to young children. Playful curiosity, reassuring and clear, a light smile and expressive emphasis on dinosaur names. Medium pitch, gentle steady energy and unhurried pauses. No shouting or theatrical growling.
